picks.headline: AI and quantum chemistry combine to identify efficient blue OLED materials
picks.excerpt: Nagoya University researchers paired quantum-chemistry simulation with machine learning to design boron-free molecules that emit vivid, high-color-purity blue light for next-gen OLED displays. Shows ML compressing the search for new functional materials with a real display-tech payoff.
picks.rationale: Concrete new release pairing quantum chemistry + ML to crack the long-standing efficient-blue-OLED problem; a materials-discovery beat not covered in prior days.

picks.headline: AI-powered system offers unprecedented insight into the forces shaping Earth's climate
picks.excerpt: Tel Aviv University's GOFLOW is an AI system that reconstructs hidden ocean-surface currents directly from satellite imagery, extracting dynamics previously inaccessible. A new ML method that turns existing observations into better climate prediction inputs.
picks.rationale: Distinct release (satellite-imagery method, Tel Aviv) from the earlier Argo-float AMOC card; turns existing observations into better climate inputs — an actionable geoscience-ML advance.

picks.headline: AI extracts hidden material rules from microscopic data to predict large-scale behavior
picks.excerpt: NUS researchers created ML methods that learn large-scale material behavior from microscopic data by discovering hidden variables that capture collective dynamics, cutting computational cost. A methods advance for predicting how materials evolve, relevant to energy and manufacturing.
picks.rationale: Methods-level advance (multiscale hidden-variable discovery) distinct from the Tohoku autonomous-lab card; cuts compute for predicting material evolution across energy and manufacturing.
